name: AI Intelligence Fabric
description: Core AI orchestration layer (EBD-MOD-00000001): provider routing, engine registry, confidence scoring, cost control, guardrails, and audit logging for every AI-backed feature in the platform. Real, working code at backend/src/core/ai/ - already imported and initialized in backend/src/index.js ('AI Intelligence Fabric initialized successfully' on every boot) but was never registered in this module registry, so Claude's discovery/execute system could not see it. Found via a whole-repo audit, 2026-08-28. Distinct from M400_AI_BACKBONE, M400_AI_CORE, M401_AI_GATEWAY, and M402_AI_ORCHESTRATION - four separately-built AI orchestration modules already in this registry, none of which reference this one or each other. That sprawl is a known, unresolved finding, not something this module's registration fixes.
